description: Set a key's value and publish it live. Upsert a single key's value into a profile and immediately publish the whole profile (KV rebuild + CDN purge) so the new value is live in one call. The key is inserted when new and overwritten when it already exists. `profile` is a profile name — omit it to target the project'…

description.description: Optional human note to store with the key.

key.description: Dotted key path to set, e.g. `home.cta`.

profile.description: Profile name to target, e.g. `en:prod`. Omit to target the project's default-marked profile.

value.description: New value for the key. Inserted when the key is new, overwritten when it exists.

name: i18n_keys_set
